related_questions.question: How does COVID-19 replicate itself?
related_questions.snippet: RNA synthesis. Viral genomic replication is initiated by the synthesis of full-length negative-sense genomic copies, which function as templates for the generation of new positive-sense genomic RNA. These newly synthesized genomes are used for translation to generate more nsps and RTCs or are packaged into new virions.
